issue.title: Fix the 13 ranked defects from the apollo/athena notification and log audit
issue.description: Disk pressure names the owners it could not measure, and recovery runs even when attribution is incomplete. Held workspaces stop rewriting the notification store. agent_publication and the error digest report each cause once, with true counts. Measured TUI stalls shrink. The six targeted defects (prompt_prose wire, update races, Telegram transport, Codex bundle cap, triage request-id retry, gateway WAL checkpoint) are fixed. Notifications, logs, and state files follow their stated dedup and retention rules on both hosts.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/notification_log_audit_fixes.md requests this work

issue.title: Honest disk attribution and the held-workspace re-settlement loop (items 1-2)
issue.description: outage: stop reporting unmeasured disk as 0 B/complete, measure workspace roots first, run reaping independently of inventory completeness, and make pressure notices name unmeasured owners and escalate missed recovery targets. Settle held workspaces once per evidence fingerprint, +1 only when evidence changes, and add a sase-core store guard that coalesces +1s and never rewrites the store for dismissed rows.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/notification_log_audit_fixes.md defines phase outage as one work unit

issue.title: Publication de-flap, truthful error digests, and TUI stall reduction (items 3-5)
issue.description: noise: give agent_publication per-(project, signature) backoff with standing alerts, a bounded incremental drain, and a terminal state for unrestorable prompt archives. Aggregate the error ring and digests by signature with durable true counts and pruning. Cut measured TUI GC pauses and main-thread I/O stalls, with tui_stalls.jsonl as the acceptance metric.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/notification_log_audit_fixes.md defines phase noise as one work unit

issue.title: Targeted high-confidence defect fixes (items 6-10)
issue.description: defects: add the prompt_prose artifact-link wire variant with a binding contract test, close the remaining runtime-update races, fix Telegram fallback, retry, and scope semantics, keep provider instruction bundles under their caps with a size gate, and advance bead_task_triage's generation on request_id_conflict.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/notification_log_audit_fixes.md defines phase defects as one work unit

issue.title: Gateway checkpoint fix, notification hygiene, and retention sweep (items 11-13)
issue.description: hygiene: handle SQLite's busy -1 checkpoint result and serve snapshots stale-while-revalidate. Fix the remaining notification dedup, amplification, orphan, blob-size, and no-op-write issues. Add age-based reapers that apply the stated log and state retention horizons.
